name: Obat Helpers
mission: Our mission is to equip underserved communities in Bangladesh with the tools they need to break free from the cycle of poverty. We do this by providing access to quality education and economic empowerment programs, promoting financial independence and inclusive economic growth. Our ultimate goal is to build a more equitable and prosperous Bangladesh for all.
theoryOfChange: OBAT's principal goal is to empower displaced and refugee communities through education, health and other empowerment initiatives.In order to empower the IDP camp residents and Rohingya refugees, OBAT has the following goals that it intends to achieve within the next 2-4 years.• Develop and enhance its donor base• Increase board members and enhance effectiveness of the board.• Expand the program services to cover more camp areas and people served and improve the quality of current programs• Attract nongovernmental funding, corporate and matching grants.• Employ newer and more current tools for fundraising.• Strengthen internal systems within the organization.• Increase media presence to promote organization's work• Enhance the volunteer pool

strengths_deep_dive: OBAT Helpers maintains strong operational efficiency by directing <cite id="12">82.1% of functional expenses to program activities in FY2024</cite>. This allocation comfortably exceeds the 75% sector benchmark. Independent evaluation further confirms operational effectiveness, reflected in its <cite id="1">90.3/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>. By serving <cite id="11">20,027 beneficiaries</cite> at a cost of $64.92 per person, the charity maintains a lean framework for international relief and educational empowerment.
rich_narrative.summary: OBAT Helpers operates humanitarian and development programs focused on empowering displaced and refugee communities, particularly in Bangladesh. Founded in 2004, the organization delivers vital education, healthcare, and economic empowerment initiatives to internally displaced populations and Rohingya refugees. In FY2024, OBAT Helpers reported <cite id="12">$1,591,131 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting a recent contraction from <cite id="3">$2,184,558 reported in FY2023</cite>. Despite this revenue shift, the charity directed <cite id="12">82.1% of its expenses to program services</cite>, beating the standard 75% program ratio benchmark. The organization holds a <cite id="1">90.3/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, demonstrating strong organizational performance and accountability. Operating with an average cost per beneficiary of $64.92, OBAT Helpers provides targeted direct aid. Additionally, <cite id="2">the charity's website indicates it is zakat-eligible</cite>, allowing Muslim donors to direct gifts toward eligible community development and emergency relief projects.
